events.text: Adolf Cornelius Piening was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Adolf Cornelius Piening ( 16 September 1910 – 15 May 1984 )

events.text: Adolf Cornelius Piening died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Adolf Cornelius Piening ( 16 September 1910 – 15 May 1984 )

events.text: Piening joined the Reichsmarine.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Piening joined the Reichsmarine in 1930

events.text: Piening reached the rank of Kapitänleutnant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: reaching the rank of Kapitänleutnant by April 1939

events.text: Piening moved from the surface fleet to the U-boat arm.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1940 he moved from the surface fleet to the U-boat arm

events.text: Piening carried out a single patrol out of Saint-Nazaire as Kommandantenschüler.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In May–June 1941 he carried out a single patrol out of Saint-Nazaire

events.text: Piening was appointed commander of the newly built Type IX submarine.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was appointed commander of the newly built Type IX submarine on 23 August 1941

events.text: Piening set out from Kiel on his first patrol in command of U-155.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Piening set out from Kiel on his first patrol in command of U-155 in February 1942

events.text: Piening became well known for developing the Piening Route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He also became well known for developing the Piening Route in 1943

events.text: U-155 attacked and sank MS Siranger.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: U-155 attacked and sank MS Siranger , sailing from New York to West-Africa , on 24 October 1943

events.text: Piening left U-155.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1944 Piening left U-155

events.text: Piening was appointed commander of the 7th U-boat Flotilla at Saint-Nazaire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1944 Piening left U-155 and was appointed commander of the 7th U-boat Flotilla at Saint-Nazaire

events.text: Piening made one last patrol, laying mines off Saint-Nazaire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 1945 Piening made one last patrol , laying mines off Saint-Nazaire

events.text: Piening was taken prisoner of war at the end of the war.
events.date_text: At the end of the war
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the end of the war , he was taken prisoner of war

events.text: Piening joined the new Bundesmarine navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1956 , West Germany established its navy , the Bundesmarine , and Piening joined the new navy .

events.text: Piening was appointed commanding officer of the 1. Geleitgeschwader (1st Escort Squadron).
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1959 he was appointed commanding officer of the 1 . Geleitgeschwader ( 1st Escort Squadron ) .

events.text: Piening became team leader at the Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 October 1965 he became team leader at the Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr , serving until 1969

events.text: Piening's service as team leader at the Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: serving until 1969

events.text: Piening died in Kiel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died in Kiel on 15 May 1984 .

events.text: Adolf Piening received the Wehrmacht Long Service Award 4th Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Wehrmacht Long Service Award 4th Class ( 2 October 1936 )

events.text: Adolf Piening received the Spanish Cross in Bronze with Swords.
events.subject: self
events.object: Spanish Cross in Bronze with Swords
events.quote: Spanish Cross in Bronze with Swords ( 6 June 1939 )

events.text: Adolf Piening received the Iron Cross 2nd Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 2nd Class ( 22 November 1939 )

events.text: Adolf Piening received the Iron Cross 1st Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1st Class ( 27 June 1940 )

events.text: Adolf Piening received the U-boat War Badge.
events.subject: self
events.quote: U-boat War Badge ( 1939 ) ( 28 March 1942 )

events.text: Adolf Piening received the Knights Cross of the Iron Cross as Kapitänleutnant and commander of U-155.
events.subject: self
events.object: Knights Cross of the Iron Cross
events.quote: Knights Cross of the Iron Cross on 13 August 1942 as Kapitänleutnant and commander of U-155
